## Importing transcribed compass points and tree measurements

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
por_compass_df<-read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/Poria_survey_70s.xlsx", sheet = "Poria_compass_points", range = "A1:AP83", col_names = TRUE)

#subset four compass points for testing including some with "C" and negative numbers
compass_test<-por_compass_df[c(1:4, 35:37),]

#convert bearings to fill in missing azimuths

compass_test$bear_ref_1<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="E", #test is east
                                     90 #if yes, then 90 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))

#determining weather to add or subtract the degree adjustment
compass_test$add_1<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_1 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_1 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_1 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_1 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_1 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_1 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
#run the calculation
compass_test$Az_1_calc<- ifelse(compass_test$add_1==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                compass_test$bear_ref_1 + compass_test$Deg_1 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(compass_test$add_1==FALSE, # if false, 
                                compass_test$bear_ref_1 - compass_test$Deg_1 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))  
#replacing missing azimuths with calculated (if available)
compass_test$Azimuth_1 <- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$Azimuth_1), compass_test$Az_1_calc,compass_test$Azimuth_1)

#repeat for 2-4
compass_test$bear_ref_2<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="E", #test is east
                                     90 #if yes, then 90 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))
compass_test$add_2<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_2 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_2 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_2 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_2 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_2 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_2 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
compass_test$Az_2_calc<- ifelse(compass_test$add_2==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                compass_test$bear_ref_2 + compass_test$Deg_2 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(compass_test$add_2==FALSE, # if false, 
                                compass_test$bear_ref_2 - compass_test$Deg_2 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))  
compass_test$Azimuth_2 <- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$Azimuth_2), compass_test$Az_2_calc,compass_test$Azimuth_2)
compass_test$bear_ref_3<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_3 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg

                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_3 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_3 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))
compass_test$add_3<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_3 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_3 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_3 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_3 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_3 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_3 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_3 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_3 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_3 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
compass_test$Az_3_calc<- ifelse(compass_test$add_3==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                compass_test$bear_ref_3 + compass_test$Deg_3 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(compass_test$add_3==FALSE, # if false, 
                                compass_test$bear_ref_3 - compass_test$Deg_3 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))  
compass_test$Azimuth_3 <- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$Azimuth_3), compass_test$Az_3_calc,compass_test$Azimuth_3)
compass_test$bear_ref_4<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="E", #test is east
                                     90 #if yes, then 90 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))
compass_test$add_4<- ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_4 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_4 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_4 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(compass_test$Dir_4 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(compass_test$Adj_4 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_4 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
compass_test$Az_4_calc<- ifelse(compass_test$add_4==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                compass_test$bear_ref_4 + compass_test$Deg_4 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(compass_test$add_4==FALSE, # if false, 
                                compass_test$bear_ref_4 - compass_test$Deg_4 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))  
compass_test$Azimuth_4 <- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$Azimuth_4), compass_test$Az_4_calc,compass_test$Azimuth_4)



#first change "C" Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4 to "0"
compass_test$Y_1 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_1 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_1))
compass_test$Y_2 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_2 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_2))
compass_test$Y_3 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_3 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_3))
compass_test$Y_4 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_4 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_4))

#make sure xs, ys, azimuths, distances are dbl not chr
#glimpse(compass_test)
compass_test$X_1 <- as.double(compass_test$X_1)
compass_test$Y_1 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_1)
compass_test$Y_2 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_2)
compass_test$Dist_2 <- as.double(compass_test$Dist_2)
compass_test$Azimuth_2 <- as.double(compass_test$Azimuth_2)
compass_test$X_3 <- as.double(compass_test$X_3)
compass_test$Y_3 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_3)
compass_test$Dist_3 <- as.double(compass_test$Dist_3)
compass_test$Azimuth_3 <- as.double(compass_test$Azimuth_3)
compass_test$X_4 <- as.double(compass_test$X_4)
compass_test$Y_4 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_4)
compass_test$Dist_4 <- as.double(compass_test$Dist_4)
compass_test$Azimuth_4 <- as.double(compass_test$Azimuth_4)
#glimpse(compass_test)

#then convert chain grid to computer grid
compass_test$comp_X_1 <- (-(compass_test$X_1 /2))+17 
compass_test$comp_X_2 <- (-(compass_test$X_2 /2))+17 
compass_test$comp_X_3 <- (-(compass_test$X_3 /2))+17 
compass_test$comp_X_4 <- (-(compass_test$X_4 /2))+17 

compass_test$comp_Y_1 <- (compass_test$Y_1 + 10) /2
compass_test$comp_Y_2 <- (compass_test$Y_2 + 10) /2
compass_test$comp_Y_3 <- (compass_test$Y_3 + 10) /2
compass_test$comp_Y_4 <- (compass_test$Y_4 + 10) /2

#create a distance grid measured in feet, based on the computer grid
compass_test$ft_X_1 <- compass_test$comp_X_1 * 132
compass_test$ft_X_2 <- compass_test$comp_X_2 * 132
compass_test$ft_X_3 <- compass_test$comp_X_3 * 132
compass_test$ft_X_4 <- compass_test$comp_X_4 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_1 <- compass_test$comp_Y_1 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_2 <- compass_test$comp_Y_2 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_3 <- compass_test$comp_Y_3 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_4 <- compass_test$comp_Y_4 * 132

#calculate slope-corrected distances if necessary
compass_test$Dist_1_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_1'), compass_test$Dist_1, compass_test$Dist_1*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_1' /100)))
compass_test$Dist_2_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_2'), compass_test$Dist_2, compass_test$Dist_2*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_2' /100)))
compass_test$Dist_3_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_3'), compass_test$Dist_3, compass_test$Dist_3*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_3' /100)))
compass_test$Dist_4_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_4'), compass_test$Dist_4, compass_test$Dist_4*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_4' /100)))


##########################REVERSE THE BEARINGS SINCE THE MEASUREMENT WAS FROM THE COMPASS TO THE GRID##########################
compass_test$Azimuth_1_flip <-compass_test$Azimuth_1 + 180
compass_test$Azimuth_2_flip <-compass_test$Azimuth_2 + 180
compass_test$Azimuth_3_flip <-compass_test$Azimuth_3 + 180
compass_test$Azimuth_4_flip <-compass_test$Azimuth_4 + 180

#Calculate cartesian coordinates for compass stations relative to ft grid (convert compass station chain coords to ft grid)

#calculation cartesian coordinates for tree relative to compass stations

#see this post for converting bearing and distance (polar) to Cartesian coordinates

#https://www.r-bloggers.com/2007/10/convert-polar-coordinates-to-cartesian/
#define function
polar2cart<-function(x,y,dist,bearing,as.deg=FALSE){
  ## Translate Polar coordinates into Cartesian coordinates
  ## based on starting location, distance, and bearing
  ## as.deg indicates if the bearing is in degrees (T) or radians (F)
  
  if(as.deg){
    ##if bearing is in degrees, convert to radians
    bearing=bearing*pi/180
  }
  
  newx<-x+dist*sin(bearing)  ##X
  newy<-y+dist*cos(bearing)  ##Y
  return(list("x"=newx,"y"=newy))
}

#run function on each station using degrees=true
new_1<-polar2cart(compass_test$ft_X_1, compass_test$ft_Y_1, compass_test$Dist_1_cor, compass_test$Azimuth_1_flip, TRUE)
new_2<-polar2cart(compass_test$ft_X_2, compass_test$ft_Y_2, compass_test$Dist_2_cor, compass_test$Azimuth_2_flip, TRUE)
new_3<-polar2cart(compass_test$ft_X_3, compass_test$ft_Y_3, compass_test$Dist_3_cor, compass_test$Azimuth_3_flip, TRUE)
new_4<-polar2cart(compass_test$ft_X_4, compass_test$ft_Y_4, compass_test$Dist_4_cor, compass_test$Azimuth_4_flip, TRUE)
#plot reference and derived coordinates and connect them with a line

points(new_1$x,new_1$y,col="red")
points(compass_test$ft_X_2,compass_test$ft_Y_2)

points(new_3$x,new_3$y,col="green")
points(compass_test$ft_X_4,compass_test$ft_Y_4)
points(new_4$x,new_4$y,col="gray")

# Create data frame with line-values
multiple_segments_1 <- data.frame(x0 = compass_test$ft_X_1,   
                       y0 = compass_test$ft_Y_1,

 # Draw multiple lines                       
 segments(x0 = multiple_segments_1$x0,                   
         y0 = multiple_segments_1$y0,

         y1 = multiple_segments_1$y1)

 multiple_segments_2 <- data.frame(x0 = compass_test$ft_X_2,   
                       y0 = compass_test$ft_Y_2,
                       x1 = new_2$x,

 segments(x0 = multiple_segments_2$x0,                   
         y0 = multiple_segments_2$y0,

         y1 = multiple_segments_2$y1)
 
 multiple_segments_3 <- data.frame(x0 = compass_test$ft_X_3,   
                       y0 = compass_test$ft_Y_3,
                       x1 = new_3$x,
                       y1 = new_3$y)
                         
 segments(x0 = multiple_segments_3$x0,                   
         y0 = multiple_segments_3$y0,
         x1 = multiple_segments_3$x1,
         y1 = multiple_segments_3$y1)

  multiple_segments_4 <- data.frame(x0 = compass_test$ft_X_4,   
                       y0 = compass_test$ft_Y_4,
                       x1 = new_4$x,
                       y1 = new_4$y)
                         
 segments(x0 = multiple_segments_4$x0,                   
         y0 = multiple_segments_4$y0,
         x1 = multiple_segments_4$x1,
         y1 = multiple_segments_4$y1)
```
